description: Defines the QpackProgressiveDecoder class for decoding HTTP/3 QPACK header blocks, including nested interfaces for handling headers, stream blocking, and decoding completion, along with private decoding logic and state management.

classes.name: QpackProgressiveDecoder
classes.description: Main class for decoding a single QPACK header block, managing decoding state, stream blocking, and error handling.

classes.name: HeadersHandlerInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling decoded headers and decoding completion or errors.

classes.name: BlockedStreamLimitEnforcer
classes.description: Interface for enforcing stream block limits during decoding.

classes.name: DecodingCompletedVisitor
classes.description: Interface for notification when decoding is finished.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Provides a data fragment to the decoder.

methods.name: EndHeaderBlock
methods.description: Signals that the entire header block has been received.

methods.name: OnInstructionDecoded
methods.description: Handles successful decoding of an instruction.

methods.name: OnInsertCountReachedThreshold
methods.description: Called when insert count threshold is reached.

methods.name: OnHeaderDecoded
methods.description: Validates and processes a decoded header.

methods.name: DeltaBaseToBase
methods.description: Calculates the base index from delta and sign.
